posts.title: Factory Factory Factory: Human Judgement at Digitale Leute Summit
posts.description: Two days at Digitale Leute Summit in Cologne, one recurring question: where does human judgement come in, and where do we just trust? Notes from my 60-minute deep dive on agentic SDLC, the dark factory debate, and the people I met.

posts.title: From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering at code.talks
posts.description: I spoke at code.talks in Hamburg about moving from vibe coding to agentic engineering. About 150 people showed up on Stage 3. Notes from the talk, the crowd, the sessions I sat in, and where things go next.

posts.title: Beyond the Hype: AI Adoption, Governance, and Roles
posts.description: Greg invited me to host a roundtable at the t3 CTO Summit. More than twenty engineering leaders joined. I share the notes and examples I prepared on AI adoption, governance, and roles.
